## Shared scenes

> [The Meredith](../codex/factions.md#merediths) children gather in the old [Methodist](../codex/factions.md#methodist) graveyard and chat about their lives and local gossip. Drawn by a appetizing smell, they head down into [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) and meet the [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children, who share their cooked trout. The two families quickly bond and become fast friends while exchanging stories about their lives.
>

> The children discuss the [West](../character/west.md) sisters and [Persis Ford](../character/persis-ford.md) while chatting in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley). As evening falls, the [Blythes](../codex/factions.md#blythes) head home to [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside) while [Jem](../character/jem.md) stops to pick mayflowers for his mother.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN

_Sources: [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P50](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0050), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P58](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0058), [v5 CHAPTER IV. THE MANSE CHILDREN P62](../source/v05-c04.md#nw-v05-c04-p0062)_

> [The Meredith](../codex/factions.md#merediths) children discover [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), a hungry runaway orphan, hiding in a nearby barn loft. After feeding her at the manse, they listen to her tragic backstory and teach her about religious concepts in the graveyard. [Faith](../character/faith.md) lends her clean clothes, and the children take her to [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) before finding her a place to sleep in their garret.
>

> [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) arrange a bed in the garret for Mary, who is anxious about her head's cleanliness and her sleeping arrangements. Later, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) hears Mary crying in the garret and goes to comfort her. After discussing Mary's fear of going back to Mrs. [Wiley](../character/wiley.md) and a brief argument over [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md), the two girls reconcile and fall asleep together.
>

> [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) settles into life at the manse, attending church in borrowed clothes and taking over housecleaning while refusing to return to school. She forms a bond with the children in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), fascinating them with ghost stories and feats while clashing occasionally with [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md) and [Faith](../character/faith.md).
>

> Miss Cornelia investigates Mary Vance's situation, revealing that her abusive former guardian has died. Meanwhile, the children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), where Walter reads mythic stories aloud and speaks solemnly about following the [Pied Piper](../character/pied-piper.md). [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md) arrives with the news of Mrs. Wiley's death, prompting Mary to express both relief and anxiety over her uncertain future.
>

> After [Cornelia Bryant](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) cautions Mr. Meredith about [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md), Mr. Meredith speaks kindly to Mary and alleviates her fears. Encouraged by [Nan Blythe](../character/nan-blythe.md), [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) boldly visits [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) to ask if she will adopt Mary. [Cornelia](../character/cornelia-bryant.md) agrees after consulting Marshall, and Mary prepares to move to her new home while sharing her frank thoughts on life and stepmothers with [Una](../character/una-meredith.md).
>

> While Mr. Meredith and Jerry are away and [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) is bedridden, [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) try to manage the house, attend a empty [Sunday School](../codex/places.md#sunday-school), and clean the manse the following day. Faith's rug-shaking in the graveyard on Monday leads to local rumors and scandal among churchgoers. Meanwhile, [Carl](../character/carl.md) falls sick, but [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) recovers and the [Blythes](../codex/factions.md#blythes) return home shortly after.
>

> [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) informs the Meredith and [Blythe](../character/blythe.md) children that [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) have caused a scandal by accidentally doing house cleaning on Sunday, having lost track of the days. After realizing their mistake with the day of the week, the group talks about their ideas of heaven before heading home, with [Faith](../character/faith.md) reassuring [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) that she has a plan to make things right.
>

> [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) becomes deeply absorbed in studying [German](../codex/factions.md#german) theology, resulting in complete distraction from his pastoral and domestic duties. Mrs. [Alec Davis](../character/alec-davis.md) arrives at the manse and abruptly demands to adopt [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), which Mr. Meredith firmly refuses. Outraged, Mrs. [Davis](../character/davis.md) berates him for neglecting his children, leaving him shaken and reflecting on how to properly care for his family.
>

> After [Dan Reese](../character/dan-reese.md) insults [Faith](../character/faith.md) and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), [Walter Blythe](../character/walter-blythe.md) confronts him and agrees to a fight the next evening. Despite his dread, Walter wins the battle after school, defending [Faith](../character/faith.md) and his mother. On his way home through [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), he meets Mr. Meredith, who approves of his fighting for a good cause, and [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md) later comforts him after hearing what happened.
>

> [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) meets [Nan](../character/nan-blythe.md), Di, [Faith](../character/faith.md), and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), boasting about her new clothes and squirrel-fur muff. [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) secretly feels envious and shabby until Mary offers her the muff to try, though [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) stiffly declines. When Mary casually mentions that [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) killed a rooster for dinner, [Faith](../character/faith.md) panics realizing it must be her beloved rooster [Adam](../character/adam.md) and rushes off in a rage.
>

> [Faith](../character/faith.md) is furious with [Aunt Martha](../character/aunt-martha.md) for killing her pet rooster, [Adam](../character/adam.md), to feed the visiting minister, Mr. [Perry](../character/perry.md). During dinner and a subsequent conversation in the study, [Faith](../character/faith.md) deeply dislikes the pompous Mr. [Perry](../character/perry.md) for his condescending lecture. When his coat-tails catch fire from the hearth, [Faith](../character/faith.md) deliberately refrains from interrupting him, leaving Mr. [Perry](../character/perry.md) enraged and his coat scorched.
>

> In [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), [Faith](../character/faith.md) meets [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md), who warmly comforts her about the death of her pet rooster, [Adam](../character/adam.md), and promises to give her a canary. [Faith](../character/faith.md) returns home feeling comforted and enthusiastically praises Miss West to her family during supper.

> [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) lectures the Meredith children in the graveyard about their bad behavior and the gossip it causes, including rumors of their father remarrying. After Mary leaves, [Jem](../character/jem.md) joins the children and suggests they form a [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) to discipline themselves. Inspired by Jem's advice, [Faith](../character/faith.md), Jerry, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md), and [Carl](../character/carl.md) agree to form the club to manage their own conduct.
>

> [The Meredith](../codex/factions.md#merediths) children form the [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club), agreeing on rules and self-punishment to avoid dishonoring their father, and sign their document in the graveyard. Afterward, [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) expresses her fears to [Faith](../character/faith.md) about the rumors that their father might marry Miss West, worried that stepmothers become cruel and turn fathers against their children.
>

> [Faith](../character/faith.md) gives her shoes and good stockings to a cold, barefoot girl named [Lida Marsh](../character/lida-marsh.md), only to realize afterwards that her only remaining option for Sunday church is a hideous pair of striped stockings. Refusing to wear them or fake an illness, [Faith](../character/faith.md) stands on a snowbank trying to catch a cold so she can legitimately stay home. Jerry and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) forcibly pull [Faith](../character/faith.md) off the snow while passing townspeople overhear their noisy argument.
>

> [Faith](../character/faith.md) causes a scandal in [Glen](../codex/places.md#glen) St. Mary by attending church without stockings, sparking community gossip and concern among [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md) and Miss Cornelia. In [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), the other children discuss the incident, and Jerry punishes [Faith](../character/faith.md) via the [Good-Conduct Club](../codex/factions.md#good-conduct-club) by making her wear her hated striped stockings. To clear her father of any blame, [Faith](../character/faith.md) writes a detailed letter of explanation to the local newspaper.
>

Prompted by Cornelia's feedback, Mr. Meredith confronts his children about singing in the churchyard during the prayer meeting. Doctor [Gilbert Blythe](../character/gilbert-blythe.md) revives her and prescribes a solid meal, leaving [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md) guilt-ridden about neglecting his motherless children.

> The children gather in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) to read and talk about their future plans. [Mary Vance](../character/mary-vance.md) arrives thoroughly startled and tells them the story of Henry Warren's ghost haunting the nearby [Bailey](../codex/places.md#bailey) garden. After cooking and eating dinner together, the children disperse, with the [Merediths](../codex/factions.md#merediths) nervously heading home alone while avoiding the haunted garden.

> In [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley) at dusk, [Faith](../character/faith.md), [Carl](../character/carl.md), and [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) mistake Mrs. [Stimson](../character/stimson.md) hunting for a lost knitting needle under a sheet for the ghost of [Henry Warren](../character/henry-warren.md) and flee in panic. Running to [Ingleside](../codex/places.md#ingleside), they report their terror to [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) and [Susan Baker](../character/susan.md). [Susan](../character/susan.md) investigates with a pitchfork and returns with the embarrassing truth, leaving the children deeply mortified.

> Jerry decrees punishments for his siblings' cowardice, ordering [Carl](../character/carl.md) to sit alone in the graveyard until midnight. [Carl](../character/carl.md) bravely completes the ordeal in a chilling rainstorm, but comes down with severe pneumonia as a result. After fighting through a dangerous crisis with Dr. Blythe's care, [Carl](../character/carl.md) recovers and is welcomed back by his friends and family.

> [Una Meredith](../character/una-meredith.md) visits [Rosemary West](../character/rosemary-west.md) to ask her to marry her father, [John Meredith](../character/john-meredith.md), willing to risk having a stepmother for her father's happiness. [Rosemary](../character/rosemary-west.md) reassures [Una](../character/una-meredith.md) that she will be a friend rather than a cruel stepmother and gives her a note for her father, which restores John Meredith's spirits upon receiving it.
>
> — v5 · CHAPTER XXXIV. UNA VISITS THE HILL

> In the evening, [Anne](../character/anne-shirley.md), Miss Cornelia, and [Susan](../character/susan.md) discuss the upcoming double wedding and the arrangements for the children while the newlyweds are away. Meanwhile, in [Rainbow Valley](../codex/places.md#rainbow-valley), the children gather on Jem's last evening before he leaves for Queen's [Academy](../codex/places.md#queen-s-academy), where Walter and [Jem](../character/jem.md) speak of battles and following the Pied Piper's call into the future.
>
